match.description: Match contains a single CEL expression

all.description: All acts as a logical AND operator on its list of CEL expressions

any.description: Any acts as a logical OR operator on its list of CEL expressions

not.description: Not acts as a logical NOT operator of a single CEL expression

none.description: None acts as a logical NOR operator on its list of CEL expressions (i.e. none of the expressions matches)

opa.description: OPA contains an OPA (Open Policy Agent) Rego script

octelium.api.main.core.v1.Condition.title: Condition
octelium.api.main.core.v1.Condition.description: Condition is a policy-as-code expression that is evaluated against the request context. It is used by the Policy rules, the Service dynamic configuration rules, the HTTP Plugins as well as by the IdentityProvider rules.

of.description: Of is the list of the Conditions that must all match

octelium.api.main.core.v1.Condition.All.title: All
octelium.api.main.core.v1.Condition.All.description: All acts as a logical AND operator on its list of Conditions

of.description: Of is the list of the Conditions of which at least one must match

octelium.api.main.core.v1.Condition.Any.title: Any
octelium.api.main.core.v1.Condition.Any.description: Any acts as a logical OR operator on its list of Conditions

of.description: Of is the list of the Conditions of which none must match

octelium.api.main.core.v1.Condition.None.title: None
octelium.api.main.core.v1.Condition.None.description: None acts as a logical NOR operator on its list of Conditions

inline.description: Inline is the OPA Rego script directly provided as a string

octelium.api.main.core.v1.Condition.OPA.title: OPA
octelium.api.main.core.v1.Condition.OPA.description: OPA evaluates the Condition via an Open Policy Agent Rego script

name.description: Name is the name of the inline Policy

octelium.api.main.core.v1.InlinePolicy.title: Inline Policy
octelium.api.main.core.v1.InlinePolicy.description: InlinePolicy is a Policy that is defined inline within the resource that attaches it instead of being created as a standalone Policy resource.

rules.description: Rules is the list of Policy rules

enforcementRules.description: EnforcementRules is the list of enforcement rules that are typically used as a precondition for using the Policy rules. You can simply extract your shared conditions from your rules and write them instead inside enforcementRules for better performance and readability

attrs.description: Attrs is a map of user-defined attributes that can be reused inside the Policy rules. It is strongly recommended to stick to camelCase in order to be conformant with Octelium's API naming conventions.

isDisabled.description: IsDisabled disables (i.e. deactivates) the Policy. You can use this to temporarily disable enforcing the Policy altogether instead of having to delete it or de-attach it from the different Resources attaching it.

condition.description: Condition is the enforcement rule's Condition

effect.title: Effect
effect.description: Effect is the decision of the EnforcementRule once its Condition matches

octelium.api.main.core.v1.Policy.Spec.En.title: Enforcement Rule
octelium.api.main.core.v1.Policy.Spec.En.description: EnforcementRule is a pre-condition that decides whether the Policy is evaluated at all. If no EnforcementRule matches, or if the list of EnforcementRules is empty, then the Policy is enforced. ENFORCE rules always override IGNORE rules in the same way that DENY rules override ALLOW rules.

name.description: Name is an optional name for the rule. It is currently useful in Logs to understand which rule triggered the Policy.

condition.description: Condition is the rule's Condition that must match in order for the rule, and subsequently the Policy as whole, to match

effect.title: Effect
effect.description: Effect is the decision of the Rule once its Condition matches

priority.description: Priority is an integer that sets the rule priority level. The lower the number, the higher the priority. Currently the range of numbers is between -4 (i.e. the highest priority) and 4 (i.e. the lowest priority).

octelium.api.main.core.v1.Policy.Spec.Ru.title: Rule
octelium.api.main.core.v1.Policy.Spec.Ru.description: Rule is a single access control rule of the Policy

http.description: HTTP is the HTTP specific details.

ssh.description: SSH is the SSH specific details.

mcp.description: MCP is the Model Context Protocol specific details.

llm.description: LLM is the LLM gateway specific details.

ip.description: IP is the IP address of the downstream that issued the request

typeID.description: TypeID is the numeric DNS query type (e.g. 1 for `A`, 28 for `AAAA`)

octelium.api.main.core.v1.RequestContext.title: DNS
octelium.api.main.core.v1.RequestContext.description: DNS is the DNS-specific request details

http.description: HTTP is the underlying HTTP request details

method.description: Method is the name of the gRPC method

service.description: Service is the name of the gRPC service

serviceFullName.description: ServiceFullName is the fully qualified name of the gRPC service (i.e. the package and the service name)

package.description: Package is the name of the gRPC package

octelium.api.main.core.v1.RequestContext.title: GRPC
octelium.api.main.core.v1.RequestContext.description: GRPC is the gRPC-specific request details

headers.description: Headers is the map of HTTP request headers.

path.description: Path is the HTTP path without query params.

host.description: Host is the HTTP request `Host` or 'Authority` header value.

protocol.description: Protocol is the HTTP protocol (i.e. `HTTP/1.0`, `HTTP/1.1` or `HTTP/2`)

size.description: Size is the HTTP request size in bytes. If unknown, it must be -1.

bodyMap.description: BodyMap is the serialized request body. Currently used with JSON.

uri.description: URI is the request path including the query

queryParams.description: QueryParams is the map of HTTP request query params. Params only assumes single-valued query params. If you want to check multi-valued params then you need to instead parse the URI field.

octelium.api.main.core.v1.RequestContext.title: HTTP
octelium.api.main.core.v1.RequestContext.description: HTTP is the HTTP-specific request details

http.description: HTTP is the underlying HTTP request details

verb.description: Verb is the Kubernetes API verb (e.g. "get", "list", "create")

apiPrefix.description: APIPrefix is the Kubernetes API path prefix (i.e. "api" or "apis")

apiGroup.description: APIGroup is the Kubernetes API group (e.g. "apps")

apiVersion.description: APIVersion is the Kubernetes API version (e.g. "v1")

namespace.description: Namespace is the Kubernetes namespace of the requested resource

resource.description: Resource is the requested Kubernetes resource (e.g. "pods")

subresource.description: Subresource is the requested subresource of the resource (e.g. "log", "exec")

name.description: Name is the name of the requested Kubernetes resource

octelium.api.main.core.v1.RequestContext.title: Kubernetes
octelium.api.main.core.v1.RequestContext.description: Kubernetes is the Kubernetes-specific request details

http.description: HTTP is the underlying HTTP request details. The entire request body is available at `ctx.request.llm.http.bodyMap` which is used to access the messages (i.e. `ctx.request.llm.http.bodyMap.messages`) as well as any other field that is not normalized here.

protocol.title: Protocol
protocol.description: Protocol is the inference API protocol served by the Service.

operation.title: Operation
operation.description: Operation is the normalized inference operation of the request

model.description: Model is the model name requested by the downstream, verbatim. It is empty for the operations that carry no model (e.g. `MODELS_LIST`).

stream.description: Stream is set for the requests that ask for a streamed response.

estimatedInputTokens.description: EstimatedInputTokens is Octelium's own byte-based pre-flight input token estimate. It is neither a provider-accurate token count nor an upper bound of one and it must never be treated as a billing truth. Read the EstimateQuality field alongside it.

estimateQuality.title: Estimate Quality
estimateQuality.description: EstimateQuality is whether the EstimatedInputTokens field accounted for the entire input of the request

maxOutputTokens.description: MaxOutputTokens is the maximum output token count requested by the downstream itself. It is zero whenever the request declares none.

hasTools.description: HasTools is set for the requests that declare tools.

toolCount.description: ToolCount is the number of the tools declared by the request.

toolNames.description: ToolNames is the bounded list of the names of the tools declared by the request.

inputItemCount.description: InputItemCount is the number of the input items (i.e. the messages or the embedding inputs) of the request.

hasImageInput.description: HasImageInput is set for the requests that carry image input.

hasAudioInput.description: HasAudioInput is set for the requests that carry audio input.

octelium.api.main.core.v1.RequestContext.title: LLM
octelium.api.main.core.v1.RequestContext.description: LLM is the LLM-gateway-specific request details

http.description: HTTP is the underlying HTTP request details. The entire JSON-RPC request body is available at `ctx.request.mcp.http.bodyMap` which is used to access the tool arguments (i.e. `ctx.request.mcp.http.bodyMap.params.arguments`) as well as any other field that is not normalized here.

protocolVersion.description: ProtocolVersion is the MCP protocol version declared by the request (e.g. "2026-07-28"). It is read from the request body's `io.modelcontextprotocol/protocolVersion` metadata field or from the `MCP-Protocol-Version` request header, and it is only set once both values are validated to match whenever both of them are present. It is empty for the protocol revisions that do not declare a version.

method.description: Method is the JSON-RPC method of the request body (e.g. `tools/call`, `resources/read`, `server/discover`).

name.description: Name is the logical MCP target of the method whenever it has one. It is the tool name for `tools/call`, the prompt name for `prompts/get` and the resource URI for `resources/read`. It is empty for the methods that have no target such as the `*/list` methods.

requestID.description: RequestID is the JSON-RPC request `id` normalized into a string. It is controlled by the downstream and therefore it must never be used as a security identifier.

isNotification.description: IsNotification is set for JSON-RPC notifications (i.e. request bodies that carry no `id` and expect no response).

client.description: Client is the client information reported by the downstream itself. It is useful for auditing and debugging and it is NOT an identity. Use the authenticated User, Session, Device and Groups for access control.

capabilities.description: Capabilities is the list of the capability identifiers declared by the downstream for this request (e.g. "elicitation"). It is self-reported.

sessionID.description: SessionID is the value of the `Mcp-Session-Id` request header used by the protocol revisions between 2025-03-26 and 2025-11-25. It is an MCP transport identifier that is unrelated to the Octelium Session.

octelium.api.main.core.v1.RequestContext.description: MCP is the Model Context Protocol-specific request details

version.description: Version is the version reported by the downstream client itself

query.description: Query is the SQL query itself

octelium.api.main.core.v1.RequestContext.description: Query is the details of a simple query request

octelium.api.main.core.v1.RequestContext.title: SOCKS 5
octelium.api.main.core.v1.RequestContext.description: SOCKS5 is the SOCKS5-specific request details

host.description: Host is the requested destination host

port.description: Port is the requested destination port

addressType.title: Address Type

octelium.api.main.core.v1.RequestContext.description: Connect is the details of the SOCKS5 connection request

octelium.api.main.core.v1.RequestContext.description: SSH is the SSH-specific request details

octelium.api.main.core.v1.RequestContext.description: Connect is the details of the SSH connection request

inlinePolicies.description: InlinePolicies is the list of inline Policies

octelium.api.main.meta.v1.ObjectReferenc.description: ObjectReference is a reference to another Cluster resource. It identifies the referenced resource by its kind and either its UID or its name.
